children: US flow creation and industrial solutions provider's Q3 revenue rose 6%, a slight beat versus analyst expectations
Adjusted net income attributable to company rose 24% in Q3
Company authorized $2 bln increase to share repurchase program
Ingersoll Rand sees 2026 revenue growth of 5.5% to 7.0% versus 2025
Company expects 2026 adjusted EBITDA of $2.13 bln to $2.19 bln, excluding Q3 IEEPA Tariff Refunds
Ingersoll Rand forecasts 2026 adjusted EPS of $3.58 to $3.70, excluding Q3 IEEPA Tariff Refunds
DEMAND ENVIRONMENT - Co said improved demand environment and continued execution drove organic orders and revenue growth
PROJECT BOOKINGS - Industrial segment organic orders growth driven by pickup in long-cycle project bookings and continued momentum in short-to-medium cycle business
LIFE SCIENCES - Co said life sciences business saw strong orders and revenue growth
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 7 "strong buy" or "buy", 8 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the industrial machinery & equipment peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Ingersoll Rand Inc. is $87.50, about 16% above its October 28 closing price of $75.45
The stock recently traded at 20 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 22 three months ago
